title: Concept: Maven mirror configured over cleartext
description: settings.xml declares a mirror URL that uses cleartext http, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Every artifact for the mirrored repositories crosses the network unencrypted, so substitution is invisible to the build.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through settings.xml (maven).
risk: Every artifact for the mirrored repositories crosses the network unencrypted, so substitution is invisible to the build.
